title: static_files_test: make_app creates two separate blob stores (dispatcher and AppState diverge)
description: static_files_test.rs:97,110: make_app() calls make_blob_store() twice — once for blob_store_for_dispatcher and once inline for AppState.blob_store. These are two different directories. Any upload-then-download test built on this factory would fail: upload writes to one directory, download reads from the other. Fix: create one blob store, pass Arc::clone to both dispatcher and AppState.
